company.name: Icommunity
company.shortDescription: iCommunity brings back the sense of community to your neighborhood.
company.description:
Community is a community management platform that engages residents in a close gated community while supporting their needs. It is a direct communication tool for neighbors, their home owner association and the community management.  
By providing prompt facility & security services, useful information and interactive dialogue, the community comes to life as one active society.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform designed to facilitate communication and interaction within residential neighborhoods and communities.
